svg.text: Extracting a shared C ABI so Logos modules can be written in many languages
from one entangled Qt/C++ SDK → a versioned, language-neutral protocol with Qt confined to the edges
The current state — one SDK doing two jobs
two concerns entangled · all C++/Qt · no extern-C
Qt Remote Objects + plain TCP/TLS · registry · capability flow
LogosAPI wrappers · LogosModuleContext · code generator · results
other languages can’t reuse (A) · Qt-bound throughout

g.text: Qt leaks through every layer — it can’t be confined.
No provider C ABI; no protocol version.
Other languages can’t reuse the transport.
Rust is stuck on a Qt-bound, unversioned shim.
Module authoring uses bespoke per-language seams.

svg.text: Already in flight — the refactor consolidates two existing, bespoke sides
Rust staticlib + C header → generated Qt glue → Qt plugin
Both are bespoke · Qt-bound · unversioned → this refactor unifies them onto one versioned C ABI (lp_*) + one cdylib module ABI.

g.text: The proposal — a layered, Qt-free C ABI hub
language-neutral IR (de-Qt’d AST) · C++ & Rust backends
— the hub · public C ABI logos_protocol.h · Qt-free
Qt-free core (ModuleRuntime / registry) · Qt only in runtime_qt / logos_host
consumer of lp_* · logos_sdk_* = back-compat facade
— Rust = dynamic calls only; no LIDL types
— No way to ask “can I load this module?”
+ Transport in logos-protocol behind one C ABI
+ Qt confined to 4 places; SDK/modules Qt-free
+ One common cdylib module-impl ABI (C++ & Rust)
Qt, confined to exactly four places
Everything else is Qt-free standard C++ / Rust:
the protocol C ABI · logos-cpp-sdk · logos-rust-sdk · liblogos core · all module code (C++ universal impls + Rust)
One version, one rule — semantic versioning
One number. The logos-protocol semver, stamped
Module ↔ module. cpp-sdk X.Y.Z interops with
liblogos load gate. Loads iff host.major ==
Compatibility guarantee — nothing breaks on the way

g.text: Out of scope: the cpp-sdk link-level binary ABI (everything rebuilds from source in this Nix workspace).
= component that links Qt (kept to the edges)
Logos modular platform · proposal overview · one rule governs all: same protocol MAJOR
Generalizes work already underway: logos-module-client + logos-rust-sdk (consumer) and the c-ffi interface of logos-module-builder (provider/authoring).
